title: Early Childhood Curriculum
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Early Childhood Curriculum Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of the value of provocations and child-led inquiry.
Create a play-based curriculum that supports children’s cognitive, language, creative, physical, and social/emotional development.

Design and implement a curriculum based on observation and assessment to support play and learning using developmental, inclusive, and anti-bias principles, in collaboration with families, in order to support all children.
Assess and document the active implementation of planned activities to demonstrate an understanding of the ongoing process of curriculum development.

Demonstrate the teacher’s role in applying theory to practice including children’s home language, culture, brain development, diverse abilities, and learning modalities, reflecting anti-bias principles.
Define how artistic and aesthetic experiences contribute to a child’s overall development both typically and atypically

notes: Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (CH DEV 001, 002, 007, 008, 011, 022, 034, 035); treated as the closed-list courses CH DEV 1, 2, 7, 8, 11, 22, 34, 35, not catalog additions.
Total taken from 'Major Units: 28' and 'REQUIRED COURSES (28 UNITS)'; listed course units sum to 28.
PDF line-break hyphenation in outcomes (e.g., 'cog -nitive', 'pro -cess') was rejoined into single words; outcome 6 is printed without a final period.

Careers are read from the description phrase 'professional development units for Child Development Permit holders, preschool, transitional kindergarten, and early primary teachers'; 'preschool' and 'transitional kindergarten' modify 'teachers' in the source — reviewer may prefer to treat these as audiences rather than careers.
Catalog section text calls the award 'Early Childhood Curriculum of Achievement Certificate' in its description (apparent typo).
